name: tuxracer-bunny-run
note: Bunny Hill from the race debug command; the paddle press at frame 10 skips the intro once both hosts are in it: paddle, turns, a jump and a braking turn; the Box3D slide must match on every host.

name: tuxracer-tree
note: A tree hit, felt in the pad and not in the camera: Bunny Hill, paddling and holding right until Tux runs into the trees at tick 569 (race.tree_hits). cam.offset holds the camera as drawn against the view on the frames within half a second of a tree hit or a touchdown: none off. cw.rumble is the engine's last request, the tree hit (heavy 0.9, light 0.5). Tux Racer never shook; this pins that it still does not. Control: holding left from frame 60 instead, no tree.

name: tuxracer-quality
note: a program for everything drawn at every quality on both backends, through a spread warm-up as a player gets it: every course, sunny, cloudy and by night, the title. A scene not reached fails. Control: a state the scene draws out of the table must be reported and skip draws

name: tuxracer-programs
note: a program for every draw state over a whole run on the cart through romdev, GL and WebGPU: the title, races at every preset, the preset switched mid-race both ways and through every preset; fails on any state the cart logs with no program, any skipped draw and the red no-program banner in any kept frame. Control: the v0.29.1 release cart (--cart <it> --expect-fail) is caught (the High terrain's shadow state at Very Low after Ultra, Tux's feathers under the High probes after a switch)

name: tuxracer-newcomer
note: the Cup by a newcomer on the cart, by the pad and the screen alone, GL and WebGPU: from power-on A opens the Cup and races its first course; steering by the trees and herring the view draws (a look every 100 ms acted on 0.3 s late, a wandering aim, looks away), the newcomer passes the first race by the requirements the card and the HUD show (herring needed, a time limit) and finds the second race open, then passes the second and third within the Cup's four lives. Controls: the original's rule (every herring near par, opt cuprule original) and the herring and trees not drawn each leave the first race not passed

name: tuxracer-tricks
note: trick mode on the cart, GL and WebGPU: the stick held through a jump spins Tux, a whole spin lands for 150 and a whole flip for 300, a landing part way round pays nothing, and the run's score is the original formula plus the trick points. Control: trick mode off, the same jumps pay nothing and the score is the original formula
